docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Sybylla Melvyn, sixteen and restless on a poor farm in the Australian bush, refuses to settle for the life expected of her.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Miles Franklin (1879–1954), My Brilliant Career, 1901, with a preface by Henry Lawson (1867–1922). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
